snippet.title: Home Garden Lulu
snippet.description:
Home Garden Lulu is a relaxing greenhouse simulator where you need to take care of frogs, keep an eye on flowers and plants, decorate rooms with beautiful objects.
Thanks for music Hanna & Julius

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ALTenia.HomeGardenLulu
